name: 52776 · West Liberty, IA
findings: ZIP 52776 (West Liberty) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 52776 (West Liberty) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
78% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
